title: Languages
description: The language your content is written in, and the languages it's translated into.
default_description: The language your titles, descriptions and labels are written in. Every translation is a translation from it.
default_change_hint: The content language can change only while the store has no translations.
others_description: Languages your content is translated into. A language that isn't published can be translated, but shoppers aren't served it and no market can offer it.
add_invalid: Write a BCP 47 tag, like de, de-AT or sr-Latn.
add_full: A store has at most {max, number} other languages.
add_hint: A new language starts unpublished: translate first, then publish it.
store_text_description: Text that belongs to no single product: the store's description and email footer, and the labels of the search filters.
store_text_empty: Add a language to translate it.
remove_description: Every translation into {name} is deleted for good, across the whole store. This can't be undone.
remove_action: Remove language and delete its translations
in_use_hint: Take the language off these markets first:
store_form_description: The language your content is written in, and the time zone times are shown in.
store_form_hint: Change it, and add translations, in <link>Languages</link>.
